steps.title: Analyze AAPT Build Failure
steps.description: Inspect the build log to identify the root cause of the compilation failure in activity_main.xml layout resource.

steps.title: Locate Incompatible Layout Attribute
steps.description: Identify that the root RelativeLayout in activity_main.xml has layout_width configured as 'match_size' instead of 'match_parent'.

steps.title: Correct Layout Width in XML
steps.description: Replace 'match_size' with the valid Android attribute value 'match_parent' to ensure proper AAPT resource linking.

steps.title: Verify Main Menu Layout Components
steps.description: Ensure the relative and linear layouts inside the workspace conform to standard layout width rules.

steps.title: Check AndroidManifest Configuration
steps.description: Verify namespace validation, correct package parameters, and launcher activity setup for Brain Blitz.

steps.title: Validate Gradle Dependencies
steps.description: Ensure compilation options are set to Java 1.8 compatibility level inside app/build.gradle with standard build tools.

steps.title: Inspect Game Loop in MainActivity
steps.description: Verify code execution logic for the three training games: Memory Matrix, Math Sprint, and Stroop Reflex.

steps.title: Review Sound and Score Storage
steps.description: Ensure ToneGenerator logic and SharedPreferences storage conform to safe Java SDK specifications.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 Syntax Compliance
steps.description: Ensure no lambdas, streams, or post-Java-8 functional interfaces are used in MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Perform XML Manifest Namespace Validation
steps.description: Double check the root manifest node uses the correct official android namespace URL.

steps.title: Confirm App Meta Information
steps.description: Validate app-meta.json contains the correct package name and app name parameters.

steps.title: Building Brain Blitz
steps.description: Trigger final APK assembly using the corrected resource files.
